summary: ClientCore bulk import maps an absent owner column to the importing user.
TalentFlow defines application withdrawn as terminal and not reopenable by employers.
The shared mail gateway documents request keys, but TalentFlow does not yet pass one during retry.
A proposal suggests deleting duplicate CRM activities by timestamp alone.
The timestamp-only proposal is rejected because legitimate calls can share a timestamp.
CC-214 adopts source event ID plus tenant ID as the activity deduplication key.
Customers report duplicate interview reminder emails after transient gateway failures.
The team initially suspects the queue visibility timeout.
TF-184 identifies missing idempotency key forwarding in retryNotification as the duplicate-email cause.
TF-184 is fixed and regression-tested; queue visibility timeout remains 90 seconds.
Security restricts candidate resume download URLs to five minutes.
ClientCore account archival hides accounts from default search but preserves activities for audit.
TalentFlow employer account suspension blocks new job posts without hiding existing public listings.
An old onboarding page still says all products use a 60-second queue visibility timeout.
ClientCore CSV import error code CC_IMPORT_017 is confirmed to mean unknown owner email.
Leadership discusses an unreleased enterprise compensation analytics feature under restricted access.
Support asks whether ClientCore supports automatic contact merging; the team confirms there is insufficient approved behavior.
A maintained terminology page clarifies project-specific meanings of account and status.
